critique: The warm orange glow on black reads clearly as fireflies, and the t1-to-t4 comparison now shows a noticeable shifting, irregular swarm rather than a fully static grid. However, it is still a very tight, uniformly dense bright knot near the center. The intended magical firefly swarm should feel more spacious and naturally dispersed, with individual lights lingering as they wander instead of reading as a compact particle burst.

suggestions.why: Widen the emitter horizontally so the swarm occupies a broader, less clumped area.
Widen the emitter vertically to create a more organic, dispersed cloud rather than a compact central cluster.
Let particles persist longer so individual fireflies visibly linger and wander between frames.
Reduce new-particle density to preserve readable individual fireflies after increasing their lifespan and swarm area.
